1.note: Central underground car park a short walk from the cathedral. Burgos ZBE rules for unlabelled cars not yet checked; see tracker.
Bilbao's ZBE (Abando) bars unlabelled cars only Mon–Fri 07:00–20:00. You arrive on Saturday and leave on Sunday, so a central garage is fine.

2.n: Itzurun beach and the flysch cliffs
2.note: Short detour off the N-634; park in Zumaia and walk 5 minutes to the cliff path.
Large free white-zone car park by the beach, close to the centre. Alternative: paid port car park, €1.20/h, free on Sundays and holidays.
494 free spaces near Anoeta stadium, outside the centre where unlabelled cars are banned 24/7. Bus 28 from Begiristain 1 (10-minute walk). Alternative: Igara P+R, free up to 24h, buses 5 and 25.
5 boulevard du Général de Gaulle, a 10-minute walk along the front to the Rocher de la Vierge.

3.note: Under place Clemenceau, a block from the Boulevard des Pyrénées.

3.n: Cité car parks P1 (Porte Narbonnaise) or P2 (Porte d'Aude)
3.note: Daytime €1 per 15 min for the first 2 hours, then €0.50 per 45 min. Free 20:00–08:00, so ideal for an evening walk up to the floodlit walls.

4.note: D981, Vers-Pont-du-Gard. €9 per car whatever the stay; open all year 08:00–midnight. Pay at the machines or by card at the exit.
4.q: Parking Pont du Gard rive gauche

4.note: Walk through cork oaks to a view west to Saint-Tropez and east along the Estérel.
Listed site with a view over the golfe de La Napoule.
5-minute climb from a bend near Miramar; Lérins islands and the Alps. Pull fully off the road; lay-bys are small.
23 rue de la République, at the foot of the old town. Or use your hotel's garage.

5.note: Free from 1 November to the end of March (12 hours continuous). Steps from the citadel and the harbour.
5.q: Parking Fossés de la Citadelle Villefranche-sur-Mer

5.n: Place Fighiera / place de la Colette
5.note: At the foot of the village on the Moyenne Corniche. €3.20/h 06:00–20:00, first 15 min free; card or cash.
Best for the palace and old town on the Rock. First hour free, about €7.30 for 2 hours, €24 for 24 hours. Same rates at weekends.

5.n: Col d'Èze and Fort de la Revère
5.note: Viewpoints over Cap Ferrat and Èze on the drive back to Menton.

6.note: Free car park outside the walls with a shuttle to Piazza dei Miracoli (€1 return, about 09:00–17:00 in winter). Closer but paid: Via Cammeo, behind the square, €2/h. Never drive inside the walls (ZTL).
Outside the walls, video-monitored, cheaper hourly rates and day tickets; walk in through the nearest gate.

7.note: Park outside the village and walk in. Check signs on arrival.

7.n: Vineyard lay-bys between Castellina and Greve
7.note: The prettiest stretch of the Chiantigiana; pull fully off on gravel shoulders only.

7.n: Car parks at the edge of town
7.note: Park before the piazza and walk in.
Florence is off-limits to the car; Figline is a separate municipality with trains to Firenze SMN.

8.n: Train to Firenze Santa Maria Novella
8.note: Regional trains on the Florence–Arezzo line; holiday timetable on 26 Dec.

9.note: Below the old town, outside the ZTL, with a free lift up to the centre.
Park outside the old walls and walk up.
Lay-by at the pass; good photo stop before the descent.
Signposted up Monte Titano; check your hotel's parking.

10.n: Car parks at the edge of the centre
10.note: Park outside the canal centre and walk in. Check signs on arrival.
Outside Venice municipality; confirm it is not on the Veneto ban list before booking.

11.note: About 20 minutes to Venezia Santa Lucia; the car stays at the hotel.

12.note: Limited spaces near the castle gate. Check signs on arrival.
Molo IV is on the seafront, quickest to Piazza Unità. Silos, next to the station, is about 10 minutes' walk.

12.n: Hotel garage or P+R Dolgi most
12.note: The old town is largely car-free. Arriving from the coast, P+R Dolgi most includes two city bus tickets. Street zones are 30–120 minutes only.

13.n: Public garage Tuškanac, Langov trg or Petrinjska
13.note: Pay on exit. Street-zone SMS payment needs a Croatian SIM; meters take coins. Zones are free on Sundays.

14.note: Central public garage near Knez Mihailova and a walk to Kalemegdan. Street zones are paid by SMS (9111/9112/9113) and may need a Serbian SIM.

15.note: At the entrance where the gorge begins. Check winter opening hours on arrival.
By the museum on the riverbank.
Lay-bys on the Serbian road facing the narrowest part of the gorge; the Decebalus rock face is across the river.

16.note: Short lunch and fuel stop. Check signs on arrival.
